sentences.en: There she collapsed on the bed and started to cry – quietly this time.

sentences.en: She put the offending foot on the ground, tentatively applying a little weight, clamping a hand over her mouth to stop the cry of pain.

sentences.en: She'd never seen anyone cry as hard as he did.
sentences.vi: Cô chưa bao giờ thấy ai khóc nhiều như anh.

sentences.en: She cried until she was too tired to cry more and drifted into a vision, reliving the few moments she spent with Jilian.
sentences.vi: Cô ấy đã khóc cho đến khi quá mệt mỏi để khóc nhiều hơn và trôi vào một khung cảnh, hồi tưởng lại những khoảnh khắc cô ấy đã trải qua với Jilian.
